{

  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - next
    paths-ignore:
      - "**.md"
      - "**.markdown"
      - "**.rasi"
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - "**.md"
      - "**.markdown"
      - "**.rasi"

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-gcc:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          submodules: recursive
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
      - uses: ./.github/actions/meson
        with:
          cc: gcc
      - uses: ./.github/actions/doxycheck
  build-clang:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          submodules: recursive
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
      - uses: ./.github/actions/meson
        with:
          cc: clang
  build-gcc-wayland-only:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          submodules: recursive
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
        with:
          xcb: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/meson
        with:
          cc: gcc
          xcb: disabled
  build-gcc-xcb-only:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          submodules: recursive
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
        with:
          wayland: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/meson
        with:
          cc: gcc
          wayland: disabled",
  "rationale": "The workflow triggers on push to the `next` branch and on pull requests, producing repeated runs for the same workflow and branch/PR. The P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE pattern supports canceling superseded runs when a newer revision supersedes older checks. Adding a concurrency group keyed by workflow and ref partitions cancellation by branch/PR, so distinct branches and PRs do not share a cancellation group. The workflow contains no release or deployment work, so the contraindications do not apply. All four build jobs are preserved unchanged, maintaining intended build and test coverage.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
